label: preparing
what: A discreet gathering in the town hall tomorrow at eighteen hundred, with 200 fresh loaves for the four great-hall tables and eight installed lanterns. Builder explicitly asked that it not be discussed with me. Baker, innkeeper and freight are coordinating bread supply, delivery and payment; secretary knowingly helps clarify arrangements and payer responsibility. The purpose is unconfirmed: a celebration of my forty years of service is only speculation. Neighbour knows about lanterns and delivery inquiries, but active participation is not established; watchman reported the activity rather than demonstrably helping prepare it.
